notes: The VFM-058W is a discontinued 5.5" Full HD (1920x1080) magnesium-body viewfinder/field monitor; it no longer appears on TVLogic's current site (tvlogic.tv / tvlogicusa.com) or on B&H/Markertek, so this is the manufacturer's own datasheet PDF retrieved via a Wayback Machine snapshot (original TVLogic URL now 404s). Video I/O and grades (SDI up to 3G-SDI 2.970Gb/s, "3G-SDI Level A/B" support) are directly confirmed by the spec sheet, as are the physical rear-panel port labels (HDMI IN, HDMI OUT, SDI IN, SDI OUT, HEADPHONE, DC 6.8-12V) which are legible in the product photo on the datasheet. Two minor caveats noted per-port: the HDMI input's stated version (1.2) falls outside the allowed grade enum's minimum (hdmi-1.4), so grade was omitted rather than forced; and exact connector subtype for the headphone jack (3.5mm assumed) and DC input (barrel-style assumed) are inferred from typical form factor, not explicitly pictured/specified. Desktop/handheld accessory unit, not rack-mountable (rackUnits omitted).

ports.name: HDMI IN
ports.note: Spec sheet lists this as "HDMI(1.2Ver) Input" — HDMI 1.2 is below the lowest grade option (hdmi-1.4), so no grade tag was applied.

ports.name: HDMI OUT
ports.note: Datasheet lists only "HDMI Output" with no version stated; likely matches the input's HDMI 1.2, but unconfirmed, so grade omitted.

ports.name: SDI OUT
ports.note: Labeled "SDI OUT" on the rear panel; datasheet describes it as the "HDMI-to-SDI conversion output" (cross-converts the HDMI input to SDI, up to 3G-SDI Level A/B).

ports.name: HEADPHONE
ports.note: Datasheet lists "Audio Out: Analog Stereo (Phone Jack) / Internal Speaker (Mono)" without stating jack size; 3.5mm assumed given the compact viewfinder form factor (156x98x28.5mm) — could not confirm exact size.

ports.name: DC 6.8-12V
ports.note: Rear panel is labeled "DC 6.8-12V"; the spec table separately states "Power: DC 12V/3A (Max 6.0A)". Connector is a DC power input; exact locking/barrel type not explicitly pictured/specified in the datasheet, dc-barrel used as closest match. Ships with AC Power Cord + DC Power Adapter per included accessories.
